explanation: Faithfully states Erdős's stronger [Er92b] conjecture: for every ε > 0, all large n are sums of distinct 2^k 3^l 5^m all lying in [b₁, (1+ε)b₁). No antichain condition is stated, but for ε < 1 it is automatic, since distinct elements within a factor 2 cannot divide each other. It is correctly marked open.
